extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: dump truck (3 axles), approx. 8.3 x 2.5 x 3.2 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 1.04 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the dump body 'dump-truck_tipper' is a separate object with its origin on the rear tipping hinge (rotate around local X, a negative angle lifts the front, approx. 0 to -50 degrees); the telescopic lift cylinder stays retracted on the chassis; 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
